policy.summary: Josephine GIS download disclaimer disclaims warranties and says data is for general visual/informational reference, not for purchase or investment decisions. It does not grant redistribution or commercial derive-and-sell rights. Live FeatureServer includes owner/mailing fields — strip to keep_properties before any staging publish. Require written clearance before CDN or selling derived products.
policy.terms_notes: Disclaimer is limitation-of-liability language, not an open license. No CC/public-domain statement found on the download page.

viewer_outline.notes: Download disclaimer is warranty-only, not a display license. Viewer outline not cleared.

workflow_clip.notes: No commercial processing grant found. Clip-in-workflow not cleared until written terms.
